 Ektaa R Kapoor and TVF announce ‘The Vvaan 2’ following the success of the first instalment 
 Following the success of The Vvaan, Ektaa R Kapoor has officially announced its sequel, The Vvaan 2, on the auspicious occasion of Chhath. The upcoming film will take forward the folklore fantasy universe introduced in the first instalment, bringing audiences back to a world shaped by Indian mythology, supernatural mysteries and ancient beliefs.Presented by Balaji Motion Pictures, a division of Balaji Telefilms Ltd, in association with TVF, The Vvaan 2 marks the reunion of Ektaa Kapoor and TVF as they continue their creative collaboration to expand the story beyond the first film.Set against the mysterious forest of Vvaan, the original film introduced audiences to a distinctive world featuring a goddess, ancient folklore and mystical forces. With the sequel, the makers aim to build on this foundation and develop a larger universe titled ‘The World of Vvaan’, opening up possibilities for new stories and characters.The announcement asset offers a glimpse into the mysterious world of the sequel. It features a little girl chasing a butterfly while mystical forces follow her. The visual takes an intriguing turn as the girl's red eyes bring back memories of the climax of the first instalment, hinting at a possible connection between the two chapters.For Ektaa Kapoor, the decision to revisit The Vvaan comes following the audience response to the film and the opportunity to explore its mythology further. Rather than limiting the story to a standalone sequel, the makers are looking to establish a folklore-based fantasy universe with scope for multiple narratives.With The Vvaan 2, Balaji Motion Pictures and TVF are set to take the franchise forward, expanding the world of Indian folklore, mythology and supernatural fantasy for audiences.
